name: Qwen Image 2.1 - draw from depth (ControlNet depth)
description:
Upload a picture and the model draws something NEW that keeps its SHAPE and depth - what is near, what is far, how the space is arranged - while the prompt decides what everything actually is.

Depth holds on to volume and composition rather than outlines, so it copes with soft or busy photographs where edge control struggles, and it is the better choice for landscapes, portraits and anything where the silhouette matters more than the fine lines.

A depth map is worked out from your picture automatically - you upload an ordinary photograph. If the result follows the original too literally, lower the control strength.

The structure picture is scaled to the output size you choose, so pick an aspect ratio close to it or it will be cropped to fit.

Licence note: the ControlNet weights are Qwen Research License - research and evaluation only, no commercial use.
